name: chat_resource
reportModel:
<#list data as item>

<#if item.title??>
标题 ${item.title}
</#if>

<#if item.assignee_name??>
负责人 ${item.assignee_name}
</#if>

<#if item.state??>
状态 ${item.state}
</#if>

<#if item.start_at??>
开始时间 ${item.start_at}
</#if>

<#if item.end_at??>
结束时间 ${item.end_at}
</#if>

<#if item.severity??>
严重程度 ${item.severity}
</#if>

<#if item.reappear_probability??>
复现概率 ${item.reappear_probability}
</#if>

<#if item.priority??>
优先级 ${item.priority}
</#if>

<#if item.description??>
描述 ${item.description}
</#if>


<#assign comments = api.invoke("/work_items/"+item.id+"/comments/fetch_default",'{"n_owner_type_eq":"WORK_ITEM","n_principal_id_eq":"'+item.id+'","page":0,"size":1000}') >
<#if comments?has_content>
评论
	<#list comments as comment>
	${comment.create_man!""}于${comment.create_time!""}发表
		<#if comment.pcontent??>
		> ${comment.pcontent}
		</#if>
		${utils.html2md(comment.content!"")}
	</#list>
</#if>

</#list>
